CalibrationCurve.description:
A calibration measured as pairs, such as valve opening time against delivered volume.

Written by the platform's DispenseCalibration procedure (valves, pumps) and read by a rig
whose configuration points a CalibratedPulse at it; the rig fits the points at startup.

calibratedAt.description: When the calibration was measured, in UTC.
calibratedAt.title: CalibratedAt

machineName.description: Name of the machine the calibration was measured on. A rig warns when it is not the machine it runs on.
machineName.title: MachineName

xName.description: Name of the quantity the rig controls.
xName.title: XName

points.description: Measured pairs; the fit is done at load, not stored.
points.title: Points

payloadPath.description: Relative path of a file a consumer still needs alongside the points, such as a gamma LUT bitmap.
payloadPath.title: PayloadPath

CalibrationCurve.title: CalibrationCurve

CalibrationModel.description: How a calibration curve is derived from its points; the `OpenRigs.Core.CalibrationModel` operators' enum.
CalibrationModel.title: CalibrationModel

CalibrationPoint.description: One measured pair of a calibration curve.

x.description: The value the rig controls, in the unit of the x axis.
x.title: X

y.description: The measured value, in the unit of the y axis.
y.title: Y

CalibrationPoint.title: CalibrationPoint

DispenseCalibration.description:
What an experiment repository commits as `config/<dispenser>-calibration.yml`.

`OpenRigs.Core:DispenseCalibration.bonsai` deserialises it with the Core `DeserializeFromYaml`
and runs the procedure; the balance port is set on the workflow at run time.

procedure.description: What to fire and how to weigh it.
procedure.title: Procedure

DispenseCalibration.title: DispenseCalibration

DispenseProcedure.description:
Settings of the dispense calibration: fire known sizes, weigh the gain, write a CalibrationCurve.

Run by `OpenRigs.Core:DispenseCalibration.bonsai`. Subjects are declared to wire in a rig's own hardware

samples.description: Sizes to measure, each fired and weighed in turn.
samples.title: Samples

primingPulses.description: Pulses fired before the baseline weighing to fill the line.
primingPulses.title: PrimingPulses

primingSize.description: Size of the priming pulses; the largest sample size when unset.
primingSize.title: PrimingSize

densityGPerMl.description: Density used to turn the weighed grams into microlitres. Water = 1.0.
densityGPerMl.title: DensityGPerMl

settleWindow.description: Consecutive stable readings, after the last pulse, before a weight is taken.
settleWindow.title: SettleWindow

weighTimeoutS.description: Fail if the balance has not settled within this time, in seconds.
weighTimeoutS.title: WeighTimeoutS

fit.description: Model fitted to the points for the acceptance report; the artefact stores the points, not the fit.
fit.title: Fit

fitOrder.description: Polynomial order; used by PolynomialFit only.
fitOrder.title: FitOrder

requireMonotone.description: Refuse to write a curve that is not monotone in either direction, since a rig inverts it to look a volume up.
requireMonotone.title: RequireMonotone

DispenseProcedure.title: DispenseProcedure

DispenseSample.description: One size to measure: the dispenser fires `repeats` times at it and the gain is weighed once.

size.description: The size to fire, in the procedure's x unit: milliseconds for a valve, steps for a pump.
size.title: Size

repeats.description: Pulses fired at this size before the gain is weighed.
repeats.title: Repeats

interPulseIntervalMs.description: Gap between consecutive pulses, in milliseconds; long enough for the valve to seat.
interPulseIntervalMs.title: InterPulseIntervalMs

DispenseSample.title: DispenseSample

machineName.description: Name of the machine the calibration was measured on. A rig warns when it is not the machine it runs on.
machineName.title: MachineName

azimuthResolution.description: Number of mesh points in azimuth.
azimuthResolution.title: AzimuthResolution

elevationResolution.description: Number of mesh points in elevation.
elevationResolution.title: ElevationResolution

meshPath.description: Relative path of the mesh CSV that BonVision loads.

SerialBalance.description:
A serial balance read by the platform's dispense calibration through `OpenRigs.Devices:SerialBalance.bonsai`.

Extends `SerialDevice` with the balance's protocol.

portName.description: The balance's serial port; set on the workflow at run time.
portName.title: PortName

newLine.description: Line termination sequence used to delimit incoming messages.
newLine.title: NewLine

readBufferSize.description: Size, in bytes, of the read buffer.
readBufferSize.title: ReadBufferSize

writeBufferSize.description: Size, in bytes, of the write buffer.
writeBufferSize.title: WriteBufferSize

printCommand.description: Command that makes the balance print one reading.
printCommand.title: PrintCommand

printPeriodS.description: How often a reading is requested, in seconds.
printPeriodS.title: PrintPeriodS

bootDelayS.description: Wait after opening the port before taring, in seconds.
bootDelayS.title: BootDelayS

tareDelayS.description: Wait after taring before the first reading is requested, in seconds.
tareDelayS.title: TareDelayS

unitSuffix.description: Text that follows the number in a reading; the value is parsed up to it.
unitSuffix.title: UnitSuffix

unstableMarker.description: Text present in a reading while the balance has not settled.
unstableMarker.title: UnstableMarker

ignore.description: Readings to discard, comma separated, such as the balance's error or echo strings.
ignore.title: Ignore

SerialBalance.title: SerialBalance
